end.summary:
Practised matching bird beak and foot shapes with feeding and movement.
Practised linking leaf features to plant habitats, including cactus and snowy regions.
Identified plants as living and distinguished living from non-living.
Unaided responses were correct in 3/4, 2/3, and 2/2 attempts respectively.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Atharv practised using observable features to explain how birds feed or move and where plants live. They used examples such as duck webbed feet, different beaks, cactus spines, waxy leaves, and needle-like leaves. Asha also practised the idea that neem trees are living because they take in water and grow, even though they do not visibly eat. At home, ask Atharv to choose one nearby plant or bird and name one feature and what it helps the organism do.

Bilkul, patle sui jaise patton par barf kam tikti hai aur phisal sakti hai. Tumne ise kamal ke patte se bhi joda. Ab Golu kehta hai, neem ka ped jeevit nahi hai kyunki woh chalta ya khaata nahi; uski baat mein kya galti hai?
umm... neem ka ped... wo... khaana khata hai? par khaata to dikhta nahi... mitti se... paani leta hai? to wo... jeevit hai?

Haan, neem jeevit hai. Woh mitti se paani leta hai, badhta hai, aur patton mein apna khaana banata hai; use chalte ya khaate dekhna zaroori nahi. Ab socho, paani ko dhakelne par ungliyan door-door hon to zyada paani hilega, ya chipki hui chappu jaisi hon to?
umm... chipki hui ungliyan... chappu jaise... wo zyada paani dhakelengi?

Haan, chipki hui ungliyan chappu jaisi zyada paani dhakelti hain. Batakh ke pairon ki ungliyon ke beech jhilli bhi paani dhakelne mein madad karti hai. Ab paani par rehkar machhli khane wali chidiya socho: uski chonch aur pair kaise honge?
